title: Plan Your Visit
heroParagraphs: Whether you are visiting Al Fahidi Fort for the first time or returning to reconnect with Dubai's history, we look forward to welcoming you.
Plan your visit using the information below and discover one of Dubai's oldest and most significant historical landmarks.
heroDetailAlt: Historical detail at Al Fahidi Fort
hoursNote: Opening hours during public holidays and Ramadan may vary.
addressLines: Opposite the Grand Bur Dubai Masjid
mapAlt: Map showing Al Fahidi Fort location
gettingHereIntro: Al Fahidi Fort is located in the heart of historic Dubai, within walking distance of Al Fahidi Historical Neighbourhood and Dubai Creek. The museum is easily accessible by car, taxi and public transport.

transport.name: By Metro
transport.description: Sharaf DG Metro Station (Green Line) is approximately 10 minutes' walk from the museum.

transport.name: By Bus
transport.description: Several RTA bus routes serve the surrounding area.

transport.name: By Car
transport.description: Paid public parking is available nearby.

transport.name: Marine Transport
transport.description: Al Fahidi Marine Transport Station is approximately 5 minutes' walk from the museum.

accessibilityParagraphs: Al Fahidi Fort is committed to providing an inclusive and welcoming experience for all visitors.
Accessible facilities have been incorporated throughout the museum to support People of Determination and ensure a comfortable visit.
For specific accessibility enquiries, please contact us before your visit.
accessibilityImageAlt: Accessible pathway at Al Fahidi Fort
visitorIntro: To help preserve the museum and ensure an enjoyable experience for everyone, we kindly ask visitors to observe the following:
guidelinesIntro: To ensure a safe, enjoyable, and respectful experience for everyone, we kindly ask all visitors to follow these key guidelines:

guidelines.title: Respect the Museum & Collections
guidelines.description: Please do not touch artifacts, showcases, or displays. Photography is welcome.

guidelines.title: Food, Drinks & Smoking
guidelines.description: Food and beverages are not permitted inside museum galleries. Please use designated outdoor areas for eating, drinking, and smoking.

guidelines.title: Children & Visitor Safety
guidelines.description: Children under 12 must be accompanied by an adult and supervised at all times.

guidelines.title: Bags & Prohibited Items
guidelines.description: Large bags, suitcases, hazardous materials, and dangerous or sharp objects are not permitted.

guidelines.title: Respectful Conduct
guidelines.description: Please respect fellow visitors, museum staff, UAE cultural values, and the historical surroundings. We kindly ask visitors to dress modestly.

ticketsIntro: Book ahead to plan your day. Group rates and complimentary access for People of Determination are available.
ticketContactNote: For tickets and current availability, please contact our team.
assistanceIntro: If you have any questions before your visit, please contact us or explore our Frequently Asked Questions.
